status: pre-commit — written after A8 specified the position control, before any recurrence arm
question: Is re-learning an earlier dichotomy faster than learning a matched novel dichotomy at the same stream index?
why_now: §4 is the behavioural test of the surplus reading. Scope has closed. Depth arms wait on the human μP-at-L=3 derivation. Recurrence is not blocked. Line 2: this is exposure (the schedule returns to a region), not change (a process repeating).

design.manipulation: At stream index k, either re-present task 0's dichotomy (mode represent) or replace that slot with a novel balanced dichotomy matched on s_r to the predecessor at k−1 (mode control). Prefix 0..k−1 and all arrangements are identical between the pair. A8: isolates seen-before from position and from similarity to what precedes it.
design.k_why: Lag-12 is the licensed forgetting cell. Intervening tasks are 1..11. Tasks 13..15 remain, so capacity can be read across the re-encounter rather than only at the end.

corners_refused.reason: Registered consecutive s_r=0.9 at P=16 rounds to Hamming 0 (hamming_for_readout_similarity). Every dichotomy in the stream is y_0 up to sign, so s_r(y_0, y_{k−1})=1 and a novel control does not exist. Checked on all 8 reserved stream_ids. Not a later reading. The surplus corner cannot be given the A8 test at this P.

design.stopping: matched_loss at target_loss 0.05. Sequential K=1. Not worst-of-K (that was the scope axis).
design.not: Replay of inputs. A task-conditioned head. Inserting a 17th task. Matching feature similarity at k. Treating Hamming-0 high-readout streams as recurrence.

first_slice.gamma_0.03_excluded: Not a control. Composition claims licensed at γ ∈ {1, 10}.

held_fixed.lr0_provenance: Registered pin. Not informed by the reserved set or by this axis.
held_fixed.target_loss_provenance: Registered pin. Not informed by the reserved set.

comparator.identification: Paired Δ = steps(represent, k) − steps(control, k) at the same (γ, condition, stream_id). The control is a novel dichotomy at k with s_r(y_k, y_{k−1}) = s_r(y_0, y_{k−1}).
comparator.not_the_primary: steps(represent, k) versus steps(represent, 0) confounds recurrence with position. Reported. Not a reading.
comparator.geometry: Retained α on task 0 across boundaries 8, 12, 15 is reported. Not a reading.

objects.three_corner_delta: Not used. S-LH is refused with S-HH.
objects.low_readout_delta: For each reserved stream_id, mean Δ over S-HL and S-LL. Then mean and SEM over unique n=8.

misses.rule: An arm that misses target_loss on any task is unusable for the Δ and is counted. lr0 is not re-pinned.
misses.interpretation: A miss at the re-presentation is not separable from an LR that is wrong on that cut. Report as not reaching target at the registered pin.

one_arm_first.spec: γ=10, mode=represent, k=12, S-HL, first reserved arrangement, a=0, N=300, quadratic, matched_loss
one_arm_first.why: AGENTS.md §5. Re-presentation at the catastrophic corner.

readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.savings: At γ=10, the S-HL/S-LL paired Δ 95% CI excludes 0 and the mean is negative (re-presentation takes fewer steps than the matched novel). The surplus reading has a behavioural measure independent of the geometry, on the corners where A8 is defined.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.no_difference: At γ=10, that CI includes 0. The surplus reading is not supported behaviourally. The paper says the geometric and behavioural pictures diverge.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.reverse: At γ=10, the CI excludes 0 and the mean is positive (re-presentation is slower than the matched novel). Report that. It is not savings.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.mixed: The γ=10 test and the γ=1 regime check disagree on which of savings / no_difference / reverse applies. Report the split. Do not pick a reading afterwards.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.prefix_mismatch: Paired represent and control arms differ in steps_taken on tasks 0..k−1, or in S_r on the prefix. Stop and diagnose. The streams were not paired.

operationalization.primary: Paired Δ = steps(represent, k=12) − steps(control, k=12), S-HL and S-LL, unique n=8, γ=10. 95% CI = mean ± 1.96 SEM.
operationalization.savings: γ=10 CI excludes 0 and mean Δ < 0
operationalization.reverse: γ=10 CI excludes 0 and mean Δ > 0
operationalization.gamma_1: Reported. Not the primary. If γ=10 is savings and γ=1 is no_difference, that is still savings (rich-regime). If they disagree in sign, mixed.
operationalization.prefix: For every pair, steps_taken[0:k] equal and S_r[:k,:k] equal. Else prefix_mismatch.

will_not_do: Inform lr0 or stopping from this axis.
Pool S-HH or S-LH into the Δ. Consecutive s_r=0.9 rounds to Hamming 0 at P=16.
Treat steps(k) versus steps(0) as the identification.
Interpret the slice if the prefix check fails.
Expand before the one-arm is reported.
